# 4.31 Thirty-first assembly district.
All of the following territory constitutes the 31st assembly district:
(1) ROCK COUNTY. That part of Rock County consisting of all of the following:
(a) The towns of Bradford and Clinton.
(b) The village of Clinton.
(2) WALWORTH COUNTY. That part of Walworth County consisting of all of the following:
(a) The towns of Darien, Delavan, La Grange, Lafayette, Sharon, Sugar Creek, and Walworth.
(b) That part of the town of Geneva comprising U.S. census tract 902, blocks 2026, 2027, and 2040; and tract 1000, blocks 4002, 4003, 4004, 4005, 4006, 4009, 4010, 4012, 4014, 4015, 4016, 4018, 4020, 4021, 4023, 4025, 4026, 4030, 4032, 4035, 4036, 4037, 4038, 4039, 4040, 4041, 4042, 4043, 4049, 4054, 4056, 4058, 4065, 4067, 4068, 4069, 4070, 4071, 4072, 4073, 4074, 4075, 4076, 4077, 4078, 4079, 4080, 4086, 4105, 4106, 4107, and 4108; and tract 1501, blocks 1000, 1001, 1002, 1003, 1004, 1005, 1006, 1007, 1008, 1009, 1010, 1011, 1012, 1013, 1014, 1015, 1016, 1017, 1018, 1019, 1020, 1021, 1022, 1023, 1024, 1025, 1026, 1027, 1028, 1029, 1030, 1031, 1032, 1033, 1034, 1035, 1036, 1037, 1038, 1039, 1040, 1041, 1042, 1043, 1044, 1045, 1046, 1047, 1048, 1049, 1050, 1051, 1052, 1053, 1054, 1055, 1056, 1057, 1058, 1059, 1060, 1061, 1062, 1063, 1064, 1065, 1066, 1067, 1068, 1069, 1070, 2000, 2001, 2002, 2003, 2004, 2005, 2006, 2007, 2008, 2009, 2011, 2012, 2013, 2014, 2015, 2016, 2017, 2018, 2019, 2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025, 2026, 2027, 2028, 2029, 2030, 2031, 2032, 2033, 2034, 2035, 2036, 2037, 2038, 2039, 2040, 2041, 2042, 2043, 2044, 2045, 2046, 2047, 2048, 2049, 2050, 2051, 2052, 2053, 2054, 2055, 2056, 2057, 2058, 2059, 2060, 2061, 2062, 2063, 2064, 2065, 2066, 2067, 2068, 2069, 2070, 2071, 2072, 3000, 3001, 3002, 3003, 3004, 3005, 3006, 3007, 3008, 3009, 3010, 3011, 3012, 3013, 3014, 3015, 3016, 3017, 3018, 3019, 3020, 3021, 3022, 3023, 3024, 3025, and 3026; and tract 1504, blocks 3002, 3011, 4000, 4001, 4002, 4004, 4005, 4006, 4007, 4008, 4009, 4011, 4012, 4013, 4014, 4015, 4016, 4017, 4018, 4019, 4022, 4023, 4024, 4025, 4026, 4027, 4028, 4029, 4030, 4031, 4032, and 4033; and tract 1603, blocks 1000 and 1047; and tract 1606, blocks 2023, 2024, 2025, 2026, 2027, 2028, 2029, 2047, 2050, 2060, and 2061.
